title: Dedicated autoscaling: feature flag + allowlist for bounded autoscaling, with rollout safety checks
author: Benji Okafor
release_notes: Introduce a bounded-autoscaling feature flag with pool/customer/region allowlisting. Add rollout safety checks to prevent enabling bounds without validated config and migration readiness. Adds operator override to disable bounded autoscaling quickly if needed.
content:
Title: Dedicated autoscaling: feature flag + allowlist for bounded autoscaling, with rollout safety checks

Context
We’re preparing staged rollout of bounded autoscaling (min/max replica bounds) for Dedicated pools. Prior work added bounds fields + enforcement in the autoscaler; this PR adds:
- A feature flag to gate bounded autoscaling behavior (including policy evaluation exposure to autoscaler)
- Allowlisting for early rollout (by customer org + pool + region)
- Rollout safety checks to reduce “oops we enabled it in prod for everything” and to provide a clear rollback knob

Links
- Linear: ENG-2848
- Related PRs:
  - PR #21873 (schema + validation)
  - PR #21905 (autoscaler clamp behavior)

What changed (high level)
1) Feature flagging
- New flag: dedicated.autoscaling.bounded.enabled
- New flag: dedicated.autoscaling.bounded.allowlist (supports org_id, dedicated_pool_id, region)
- Default behavior:
  - If flag is OFF: autoscaler runs existing reactive scaling path (ignores min/max fields even if present)
  - If flag is ON but not allowlisted: bounds are not enforced and policy output does not surface resolved bounds to autoscaler
  - If flag is ON and allowlisted: autoscaler + policy output run bounded path

2) Rollout safety checks
- Control plane refuses to enable bounded autoscaling for a pool if:
  - min_replicas/max_replicas missing (or invalid), OR
  - pool is multi-region (not supported for bounded rollout in Phase 1), OR
  - pool hardware class not in supported set for the rollout cohort, OR
  - migration readiness check fails (bounds backfill not completed for legacy pools)
- This is intentionally “fail-closed” for allowlisted bounded behavior to avoid partial misconfigurations.

3) Operator / emergency override
- Added a global kill switch: dedicated.autoscaling.bounded.force_disable
- When set, bounded behavior is disabled regardless of allowlist (intended for incident response).

4) Auditability + metrics hooks (minimal)
- Emit a structured info log at policy evaluation time indicating:
  - bounded_path_enabled: true/false
  - allowlist_match: true/false
  - safety_check_failure_reason (if any)
- Note: detailed decision metrics are tracked in ENG-2846; this PR only adds the minimal “rollout gating” signals to speed triage.

Why we’re doing it
- Enterprise customers want strict bounds, but we need safe activation with regional fleet constraints.
- This is a cross-component change (control plane -> policy evaluation -> autoscaler). A feature flag + allowlist keeps early cohorts small and debuggable.
- Safety checks prevent a class of incidents where a half-migrated pool ends up in bounded mode and gets pinned unexpectedly.

Implementation notes
- Flag evaluation happens in the control plane policy service to keep the autoscaler dumb: autoscaler reads a single evaluated config blob (bounded_path_enabled + resolved values).
- Allowlist matching is done with explicit precedence:
  1) force_disable => bounded_path_enabled=false
  2) bounded.enabled=false => bounded_path_enabled=false
  3) bounded.enabled=true + allowlist match + safety checks pass => bounded_path_enabled=true
  4) otherwise => bounded_path_enabled=false
- Safety check failures are returned as warnings in the evaluated config for non-allowlisted pools, but are hard errors when trying to explicitly enable bounded mode for allowlisted pools (to avoid “silent no-op” surprises during pilot).

Testing
- Unit tests for allowlist matching (org/pool/region) and precedence with force_disable
- Golden tests to ensure policy evaluation determinism (stable ordering in allowlist evaluation)
- Integration test (control plane -> autoscaler config fetch) that validates bounded_path_enabled flips behavior only when allowlisted

Rollout plan
- This PR only adds gating. Actual enablement will be via feature flag service + allowlist updates.
- Initial cohort target (per ENG-2848): 2 design partners + 1 internal dogfood org, us-east-1 only.

Commits
- control-plane: add bounded autoscaling feature flags + allowlist types
- policy-engine: evaluate bounded rollout gating and include bounded_path_enabled + failure reasons
- autoscaler: respect bounded_path_enabled (do not clamp unless true)
- tests: add golden tests + allowlist precedence unit tests

Changed areas / files (representative)
- services/control-plane/featureflags/flags.ts
- services/control-plane/policy/eval_autoscaling.ts
- services/control-plane/policy/validators/dedicated_pool_autoscaling.ts
- services/fleet-autoscaler/config/resolved_autoscaling_config.go
- services/fleet-autoscaler/controller/scale_loop.go
- services/control-plane/policy/testdata/golden/autoscaling_eval_*.json

Representative snippet (autoscaler config gate)
Before:
- Clamp desired replicas using min/max if present.
After:
- Only clamp when config.bounded_path_enabled == true; otherwise ignore bounds fields.

CI
- build (monorepo): pass
- unit tests: pass
- lint: pass
- integration: pass

Review discussion
- Ethan Park (requested changes): “We need a kill-switch that’s independent of allowlist; also please make safety checks fail-closed for allowlisted pools so we don’t ‘think’ we’re running bounded when we aren’t.”
  - Benji Okafor: Added dedicated.autoscaling.bounded.force_disable; changed allowlisted enablement to hard error on safety check failures; kept non-allowlisted warnings for visibility.

- Keiko Yamamoto: “Autoscaler should not re-implement allowlist logic. Can we treat allowlisting as a policy concern and surface a single boolean?”
  - Benji Okafor: Done. Autoscaler consumes bounded_path_enabled only.

- Jordan Lee: “Make sure allowlist evaluation is deterministic to avoid flaky golden tests / config churn.”
  - Benji Okafor: Sorted allowlist entries and normalized match inputs; added golden tests.

- Rafael Mendes: “For oncall: where do we see why bounded mode didn’t apply? We should log a reason string.”
  - Benji Okafor: Added safety_check_failure_reason and allowlist_match in policy logs. Detailed metrics coming in ENG-2846.

- Connor O'Brien: “Rollout safety check should explicitly block multi-region pools for now; we can relax later.”
  - Benji Okafor: Added multi-region block with explicit error code.

Approvals
- Ethan Park: Approved
- Keiko Yamamoto: Approved
- Jordan Lee: Approved
- Connor O'Brien: Approved

Merge
- Merged via squash into main
- Squash commit message: “Dedicated autoscaling: feature flag + allowlist for bounded rollout (ENG-2848)”

Follow-ups (not in this PR)
- ENG-2846: decision metrics + dashboards (clamp reasons, applied vs desired)
- ENG-2850: default bounds backfill job (migration readiness checks will be updated to reference the backfill completion signal)
- Docs/runbook updates for how to toggle force_disable during an incident
